method: Same original printed 60s, native controls around one symmetric actor-owned conditional Stadium candidate; unchanged native AI all other actions
sourceFrames: 8 physical seat/seed groups, each exactly 3 native arms (control, single owner-visible active attack-funded Stadium, repeated control) = 24 attempted bounded games

policyRules.when: unmodified native bot proposes Pass on a genuine owner turn
policyRules.positiveOnly: one held Stadium known to modify Lightning attack cost and turns a >=80 printed damage Active attack from unpayable under modeled current Stadium to payable under replacement
policyRules.stillUnverified: negative effect of replacing Stadium, other attack cost modifiers, opponent damage immunity, tempo and all enemy continuations

admissionChecks: identical complete initial physical deal in every A/B/A group and registered exact seed identity
bit-for-bit repeated control root ledger parity
genuine typed Store acceptance and new public Stadium custody for each actually selected action
first native action divergence is the selected physically owned paper-differently-named Stadium, no unobserved earlier changes
original opponent native actual response preserved
no completed official paper games or broader matchup win-rate claims
